description: Land Acquisition - Kanahela, Passara D/S Division, Badulla District and 3 amendments to Gaz. Ex. Nos. 1901/18, 2016/33, 2013/18 in D/S Division Badulla and Attanagalla
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific lots of land being acquired for public purpose (road widening). It contains descriptions of land parcels, their locations, extents, and purposes of acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
